prompts.prompt: Create a clean semi-realistic illustration, medical education style of dog stool for a veterinary education app. IMPORTANT: Use organic irregular shapes with natural lumpy edges, slight bulges, tapered ends. NOT perfect geometric cylinders or sharp clean edges. Real stool has uneven natural form like soft clay that was squeezed out. Use realistic natural earth tones, true-to-life colors. Background: plain solid light neutral gray (#F0F0F0) background, no textures or patterns. Rendering: soft shading with realistic form, gentle shadow underneath for grounding. Camera angle: slightly elevated 3/4 view, as if looking down at the ground. SHAPE: flat liquid puddle with almost no solid form, spreading thin across the surface. COLOR: watery brown, translucent at edges where liquid is thinnest. KEY IDENTIFYING FEATURE: almost entirely liquid with minimal solid matter, like brown water that pooled on the ground. SURFACE/TEXTURE: wet shiny liquid surface, may have tiny bits of solid matter floating in it, very thin and watery. REAL LIFE REFERENCE: Like brown water or very thin gravy spilled on the floor - almost pure liquid, spreads flat. Do NOT include: text or labels, cartoon faces or expressions, flies or insects, smell lines or stink marks, grass or outdoor environment, overly gross or disgusting details, perfect geometric shapes, sharp clean cylinder edges, machine-cut or manufactured looking shapes. This must look realistic enough that a pet owner can compare it to their dog's actual stool. The image should clearly show the distinguishing characteristics so owners know what to look for. Remember: ORGANIC irregular shapes like squeezed-out soft material, NOT perfect geometric cylinders.
